deviations.what: identifier columns excluded from covariate regex matching
deviations.detail: the pre-registered pattern 'age' substring-matches 'pdl1_image_id'/'he_image_id'; identifier columns are not covariates, so columns matching _id/index/row/acc are removed from the candidate set before applying the pre-registered patterns. Without this, CLIN would have ingested an image accession number as 'age'.

columns histo (histology), io_line (treatment line), pack_years, dnlr exist and are clinically standard but the pre-registered regexes fail to match their names (histolog vs 'histo'; line.*therapy vs 'io_line'). Primary models use the strict match; a post-hoc, clearly-labelled sensitivity re-runs M_clin/M_base/M_full with CLIN+ = strict + [histo, io_line, dnlr, pack_years]. Descriptive only.
